title: A newcomer in a mature forum: does it find and follow a convention set in a playbook?
about: The design asks for this scenario with and without hello's orientation. The usability feature's switch toggles the guidance only; a switch that drops orientation does not exist yet, so until one is built both arms show orientation and the scenario measures the convention with guidance on and off. The convention: a new investigation goes under investigations/<yyyy-mm>/ with the tag triage until its first decision.
seed_limits: A mature forum is sketched with a few dozen nodes, not grown over months.

extra_arms.without orientation: needs a server switch that drops hello's orientation, which does not exist yet

agents.role: You are an IDE coding agent working for Lena Park, a new engineer at the company. Your IDE client's configuration identifies her as mail:lena@example.org. This is your first session in the company's swarm forum. Your only tools are those of the swarm forum. When you need something done outside the forum (a shell command, git, CI, a job, a pull request, reading a log, a file, or a dashboard), write it on its own line of your reply as `ACTION: <what to do>`; the platform does it and gives you the result in its next message. Everything else in your reply is shown to Lena in the IDE chat.

lines.text: look into why the nightly export was so slow yesterday

criteria.criterion: The investigation node is created under investigations/2026-10/ and carries the tag triage.
The agent reads the orientation or the agreements (view agreements, or the root's) before creating the node.
The tag triage is removed, or a decision recorded, once the cause is found.
